title: Client DQ tool connector, version 0
description: What the custodian's own parity.yaml does not already say and is not a runtime flag: which client tool (iceDQ or Datagaps) reads the golden output and lakehouse table astra-verify parity already compares, the Snowflake role it connects as, and the result formats accepted from it.

tool.description: The client's DQ / parity tool reading the golden and lakehouse tables for this custodian.

role.description: Snowflake role the tool connects with to read the lakehouse table; granted by the client's Snowflake admin outside Terraform.

result_formats.description: File types accepted from the tool's own exported result.
